identityNote.en: Yin Xing is a general name for the ginkgo tree. The medicinal seed is Bai Guo (Ginkgo Semen); Yin Xing Ye is Ginkgo Folium, a different medicinal part.
identityNote.es: Yin Xing es un nombre general del árbol ginkgo. La semilla medicinal es Bai Guo (Ginkgo Semen); Yin Xing Ye es Ginkgo Folium, una parte medicinal diferente.
